CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_customer_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT customer_id FROM public.customer WHERE profile_id = auth.uid();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_employee_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT employee_id FROM public.employee WHERE profile_id = auth.uid();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(public.get_user_role() = 'Admin', false);
$function$
